当 $a=5、$b=1、$useOffset=true 时，$x=5$ 处的合成示例结果为 $y=5\times5+1=26$；关闭偏移后则为 25。下面所有数据均为合成数学示例。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,result,chart,table,caption,ask,reset])
$a: number = 5
$b: number = 1
$useOffset: boolean = true
let yAt5 = $a * 5 + ($useOffset ? $b : 0)
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + ($useOffset ? $b : 0), 0, 5, 6)
form = Form(children=[aInput,bInput,toggle], title="合成数学示例参数")
aInput = Slider(label="系数 a", bind=$a, min=0, max=10, step=1)
bInput = NumberField(label="偏移 b", bind=$b, min=-10, max=10, step=0.5, required=true, visible=$useOffset, unit="u")
toggle = Switch(label="启用偏移 b", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x=5 时的 y", value=yAt5, unit="u", digits=2)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], title="合成数学示例：y = a·x + (useOffset ? b : 0)", unit="u", xLabel="x", yLabel="y")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x","digits":2},{"key":"y","label":"y","digits":2}])
caption = Text(text="以上为合成数学示例数据，仅用于演示参数变化。", variant="caption")
ask = Button(label="生成参数解释草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请解释这组参数如何决定 y = a*x + (useOffset ? b : 0) 在 x=5 时的结果。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":yAt5}))
reset = Button(label="重置为默认值", action=Reset())
```
